title: Plan Monthly Savings is available with state unknown at a month rollover while settled months exist
claim: At the first cycle of a new month (2026-02-01T00:00), MonthlySavingsSensor is available and publishes None (Home Assistant 'unknown') while savings_months carries the settled January row: 1 of 17 cycles across the rollover.
mechanism: MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for returns None whenever any row exists, but native_value is a number only for the open month's estimated row with a non-None savings_sek. The two predicates disagree whenever the open month has no row yet (rollover, measured) or its row is withheld (old_basis / below_meter_floor, read from code, not measured). The _WaitsForEvidenceMixin's own contract is that 'not measured yet' is unavailable, never unknown.

evidence.unit: cycles (of 17, 2026-01-31T22:00 to 2026-02-01T02:00 UTC) with the sensor available and its state None
evidence.contention_note: shared box with other finder seats running; deterministic

perturbation.change: --gate-waiting: _waiting_for answers settled_savings_month unless an estimated row with a numeric savings_sek exists (in memory)

metric_definition: count of cycles where MonthlySavingsSensor.available is True and native_value is None
phenomenon_property: MonthlySavingsSensor is available exactly when its native_value can be a number: availability and value read the same row.
seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D8/s1/monthly.py -v (seams: no open-month row; open-month row withheld by old_basis or below_meter_floor)
reproduction_steps: run the command: the 2026-02-01T00:00:00 line reads avail True state None rows ['2026-01']
proposed_fix_scope: key MonthlySavingsSensor._waiting_for on the open month's estimated row with a numeric saving, the row native_value reads
